repos_data.description: Mumble is an open-source, low-latency, high quality voice chat software.
The command-line tool for quick, simple deployment and management of Linux dedicated game servers.
Run Windows games on Apple Silicon — free, open source, with an open compatibility database that tells you what actually works.
Active community fork of the archived whisky-app/whisky — a modern Wine wrapper for macOS built with SwiftUI
Free, open-source game launcher toolkit for Apple Silicon Macs. Set up Battle.net, Steam, Epic and GOG with separate Wine environments, Mac launch shortcuts and documented compatibility.

Read-only Steam MCP server for AI agents: 41 tools + prompts + resources across library, friends, achievements, store, reviews, sales, discovery, recommendations, and co-op planning. Official Steam Web API, bring-your-own-key, open source. On PyPI + the MCP Registry.

RuneScape 3 MCP Server (RS3) — Connect Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and other AI assistants to RuneScape Wiki, Grand Exchange prices, player hiscores, item comparisons, and money-making tools. Available as a hosted MCP server or npm package.
